# Kenz Laurenz Cotton Headbands, 6 Pack in Neutral Tones

## Soft, Stretchy Hair Control

Keep hair out of your face with this 6-pack of stretch cotton headbands. Each 2-inch band blends soft cotton with Lycra elastic, so it grips gently and moves with you from morning routine to evening workout.

## Features Built for Daily Wear

This set includes six neutral-toned bands that pair easily with everyday outfits. The cotton and Lycra blend creates a snug, flexible fit, and the 2-inch width holds hair back without bulk.

## Benefits for Busy Routines

Pull your hair back in seconds before washing your face, applying skincare, or doing makeup. Wear a band under headphones during video calls, or keep hair controlled during softball, volleyball, basketball, cheer, or dance practice. Your hair stays put so you can focus on what matters.

## Made to Keep Their Stretch

The cotton-blend fabric is easy to launder, and many shoppers say the bands hold their elasticity over time. Rated 4.3 stars by more than 2,000 customers, this set offers a practical way to stock up on dependable hair accessories.

## Add Your Set to Cart

Get all six bands for $13.98 and keep your hair neatly in place every day of the week.
